title: Interpretation 15-04 (City of Moses Lake): whether the temporary growing-structure exemption (WAC 51-50-007) covers large polycarbonate greenhouses for year-round production
jurisdiction: Washington State, requested by City of Moses Lake (comparative test only; not Alberta)

facts.text: Document type: State Building Code Council interpretation no. 15-04, one page; requester City of Moses Lake.
The question quotes WAC 51-50-007 on temporary growing structures with flexible polyethylene, polyvinyl or similar covers used for frost protection or heat retention.

Structures in question: large-scale greenhouses built from polycarbonate panels, used for year-round production of marijuana, with mechanical ventilation, grow lights and a supplemental heat source for winter growing.
